name: Hinojosas de Calatrava (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, red at the hoist and fly and yellow above and below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Hinojosas de Calatrava (a cross of Calatrava, fennel and a saint on white).
history: Municipal flag of Hinojosas de Calatrava; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
